Name: Autumn
Description: Decay, dread and endings; the shadow that lengthens over a thing.

Name: Chicanery
Description: Illusion and misdirection worked upon the mind of the beholder.

Name: Chronos
Description: The running of time — slowed, hurried, glimpsed backward.

Name: Contract
Description: Oaths, bargains and the binding weight of a promise given.

Name: DragonsIre
Description: Wrath made manifest; the body itself turned to a weapon.

Name: Legerdemain
Description: Sleight of hand at a distance — things moved, taken, unseen.

Name: Metamorphosis
Description: The shape of a living thing rewritten, briefly or lastingly.

Name: Naming
Description: True names and the words that command what they name.

Name: Oneiromancy
Description: Dreams: entering them, shaping them, walking out through them.

Name: Primal
Description: The raw stuff of the world — stone, storm, root and flame.

Name: Pyretics
Description: Fire and faerie light, from a kindled spark to a pyre.

Name: Skycraft
Description: The open air — wind, weather, lightning and flight.

Name: Soothsay
Description: Fate read and nudged; omens, portents and the thread ahead.

Name: Sovereign
Description: The right of rule, and the fae obedience that answers it.

Name: Spring
Description: Renewal, desire and the green rush of things beginning.

Name: Summer
Description: Vitality and plenty at their height; passion that will not cool.

Name: Wayfare
Description: Motion — leaping, hastening, and doors opened between places.

Name: Winter
Description: Cold, stillness and the quiet that follows an ending.
